MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #3
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

2. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

3. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

4. Solve for x: x + 8 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 10
   C. 11
   D. 8

5. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

6. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 5
   C. 8
   D. 16

7. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 49
   C. 1
   D. 1

8. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 64
   D. 65

9. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 17

10. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

11. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 90

12. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.7
   D. 19.6

13. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

14. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. Cannot tell
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

15. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 3/4

16. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 121
   C. 11
   D. 22

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 33
   C. 14
   D. 22

18. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 41
   B. 40
   C. 13
   D. 3

19. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 37

20. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

21. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 81
   C. 18
   D. 82

22. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 24
   C. 5
   D. 25

23. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 169
   C. 13
   D. 170

24. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 36

25. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 43

26. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 26
   D. 5

27. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.205
   D. 0.25

28. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 144

29. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 15.6
   D. 21

30. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
